children: UK fluid power distributor's H1 revenue rose 24% yr/yr, driven by acquisitions and market share gains
Adjusted EBITDA and operating profit increased, but gross margin declined on mix and inflation
Company expects higher H2 profitability and cash generation, supported by a strong order book
Company expects full-year results in line with market expectations for 2026
Board anticipates stronger H2 26 performance with higher profitability and improved gross margin
Net debt is forecast to reduce significantly in H2 26 on stronger cash generation
ACQUISITIONS AND MARKET SHARE - Revenue growth was driven by recent acquisitions and market share gains across all regions
GROSS MARGIN PRESSURE - Gross margin declined due to lower-margin mix from Q Plus acquisition, volume growth initiatives, and inflationary pressures
DIGITAL PLATFORM AND PRODUCT EXPANSION - New eCommerce platform and product range expansion drove customer acquisition and order book growth
